content: Without fine-tuning, the average accuracy of XLNI is 39.7% for a three-ways classification task, and the average LAS score is 3.6 for dependency parsing. We see the biggest leap in the performance after 50K updates. While semantic similarity task profits significantly at 25K updates of the target embeddings, syntactic task benefits with further fine-tuning the encoder. This is expected since the target languages might exhibit different syntactic structures than English and fine-tuning encoder helps to capture language specific structures. We observe a substantial gain of 19-30 LAS for all languages except French after 50K updates.
